goal: Bring Gleam's UI and copy into alignment with the reference design system and brand package in the sibling ao-wallet repo (screens/*.html + shared.css, brand/*.md), restyling every already-built screen and building the 4 reference screens that currently have no counterpart in the extension.
outcome: Every screen in the extension -- onboarding, unlock, wallet-main, wallet-detail, send, receive, activity/tokens, upload, connection-request, signing-approval, connected-apps, settings-home, plus newly-built network-peers, wallet-switcher, lock-settings, and cross-cutting-states -- visually and textually matches its reference HTML counterpart and the brand voice/guidelines, using one shared, consistent token set (packages/ui/src/tokens/** and shared primitives) rather than each screen's own ad hoc styling.

requirements.statement: Never introduce new business logic, handler behavior, or messaging-contract changes as part of this pass -- restyle and recopy only; any real behavior gap discovered along the way is declared debt, not fixed inline.
The single-warning-red-accent rule holds: the five-color beam is identity-only, never repurposed as a warning/error signal, per brand/guidelines.md.

Every one of the 15 reference screens in ao-wallet/screens/ (excluding wallet-main-screen.html, already the base) has a corresponding, visually-matching screen in the extension -- including the 4 currently unbuilt: network-peers.html, wallet-switcher.html, lock-settings.html, cross-cutting-states.html.

All extension copy (labels, button text, empty/error/confirmation states) matches brand/voice.md and brand/guidelines.md in register and the risk-tier confirmation-weight rules (routine/consequential/irreversible) stated there and in screens/TODO.md.

Shared visual tokens (color, spacing, type scale, the five-color beam identity element) are defined once in packages/ui/src/tokens/** and consumed by every screen -- no screen hardcodes a one-off value shared.css already defines as a token.
pnpm wxt build still succeeds and every existing layer's own test suite still passes after the restyle (no regression to already-verified behavior).
